2.2.13 Complex Types
If the RDL format specifies an optional RDL element as a complex type ([XMLSCHEMA1/2] section 3.4)
and that complex type represents a sequence collection (of children elements of the same type),
unless otherwise explicitly specified for that particular element, omitting that optional RDL element
specifies an empty collection.
